anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard, which is a technical specification used to organize and share EEG data like the one in this dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a visual P300 task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid. Each trial had a duration of 1.0 second, with events classified as Target or NonTarget stimuli. HED 8.4.0 event annotations were applied to all experimental stimuli.
